name: FINVIZ_PROACTIVE_RESEARCH_TRUTH_20261107
comment: ANCHOR: FINVIZ_PROACTIVE_RESEARCH_TRUTH_20261107 — LQ-20261107-52. Three defects in the Finviz
(1) news_symbol_guard took the issuer name from the first comma clause of
symbol_profiles.description_1s, a PARAGRAPH. For NVDA/AAPL/V the alias was the whole sentence
('NVIDIA Corporation operates as a data center scale AI infrastructure company in the United
States'), so a headline saying 'Nvidia' never matched, the health agent's remediate() counted the
rows as mis-tagged, and purge_mismatched_watchlist deleted them: 23 rows on 2026-11-06 (archive
(2) The lane wrote the TICKER into news_articles.strategy_type (440 rows, plus 369 catalyst_events
built from them) — a column topic_curator, the iris taxonomy and rag_retrieval read as a strategy
(3) The universe was holdings + watchlist[:max] in alphabetical order, so with 5,678 watchlist
symbols and --max 400 nothing after 'ALPX' was ever covered.
The test also pins what must NOT change: a contradicted 52-week level and a foreign issuer still
reject a provider-tagged row, a Yahoo row with no textual evidence still rejects, and a multi-word
issuer never degrades to a generic first word ('space'). Hermetic: synthetic cursors, synthetic
descriptions, no DB, no provider call, no network.
